releases.name: JapaneseDialect
releases.summary: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

releases.name: Magic Ball Sort
releases.summary: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

releases.name: Nie Xiaoqian
releases.summary: Nie Xiaoqian is a supernatural visual novel set in ancient China. At a ruined temple in Jinhua, scholar Ning Caichen meets a trapped young ghost. Grow closer through doubt, trust and mortal danger. Shape their story with key choices, explore different endings, and find where they belong.

releases.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
releases.summary: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a unified 4v4 team sport. Across shared middle ranks, pieces migrate between boards to flank opponents and save teammates. A true multi-board competitive variant built to completely revolutionize the team chess format!

releases.name: LINE WARLORD
releases.summary: A real-time line-battle roguelite. Spend rations to summon swordsmen, shields, archers and cavalry onto a single front, then break the enemy base. Pick relics and promotions at every fork to build a different army each run. Three commanders, three ultimates.

releases.name: Nova Survivors
releases.summary: A top-down survival roguelite. Pilot 21 unique ships, craft broken builds from cards, artifacts and weapon evolutions, and outlast endless hordes and colossal bosses across 4 worlds. Take on a 100-level Campaign with a scaling Threat level, or dive into infinite Survival. Every run is different.

releases.name: Coverage
releases.summary: A board game for two players similar to games like Othello and Ataxx. Cover the board with your pieces--or take over all of your opponent's.

releases.name: Mugen Kaidan: Danchi
releases.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in an apartment stairwell looping from the 2nd to the 10th floor. Notice changes in doors, windows, and sounds, uncover the code, and find a way to the rooftop.

releases.name: RailBlaster
releases.summary: Ride twisting rails through ten worlds that pulse with the music, blasting everything in sight. Build combos, slow time, outsmart ghosts, blinkers and walls, and face two bosses. Play on a monitor or in VR, or with up to 8 players in local split-screen.

releases.name: Overtime : Development Hell
releases.summary: Play as Frank, a developer at a highly secretive game development studio rushing to finish the studio's most anticipated release, while being disrupted by an obsessed fan trying to gain information on the long awaited game. Survive Frank's final night alone in this Psychological Horror experience.

releases.name: Mod Complex
releases.summary: A turn-based roguelite about moderating unhinged group chats. Read every message, then approve, delete, timeout or ban before the hour ends. Build streaks, install bots and survive seven servers without getting reported to the FBI.

releases.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

releases.name: The Skull of the Howard Knight
releases.summary: Today, you are a guest. So forget your troubles, take a sip of hot tea, and listen to a tale of an artifact that, according to legend, can manipulate time...

releases.name: CLUB BOSS '94
releases.summary: CLUB BOSS '94 is a free tribute to legendary 90s football management games like PC Fútbol and Championship Manager. Created by indie developer Dev Deiff, it’s packed with retro charm, pixel art, and decisions that matter.

releases.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing
releases.summary: Chum the water, watch what rises out of the murk, and land Fish Wrangler's fish.

releases.name: Guided Meditations - Calm Mind
releases.summary:
Relax and quiet your mind with soothing, voice-guided meditations. Settle in, and be guided to a more peaceful place.

Take a moment for yourself. Guided Meditations brings calming, voice-led meditation to your console — a peaceful space to relax, de-stress, and reconnect with a quieter mind, whether you have ten minutes or twenty.

No experience needed. Just pick a session, choose your setting, and let a warm, soothing voice guide you gently through every breath. Sink into tranquil visuals and softly flowing ambient sound, designed to ease away the noise of the day.

Whether you're winding down before sleep, settling a busy mind, or simply carving out a little calm in your routine, this is your invitation to slow down and just be.

Features

Soothing voice-guided meditations for all experience levels
Two calming guide voices to choose from
Shorter and longer sessions to fit your time
Beautiful, tranquil backgrounds you can select
Gentle ambient music to deepen your calm
A simple, peaceful experience — sit back, breathe, and unwind

Find your calm, one breath at a time.

releases.name: Armored Hell
releases.summary: Hold the line for the last 20 minutes. Open crates, upgrade and fuse 175 pieces of gear into a firepower network of your own. At minute 20, the final boss comes to grade your work.

releases.name: Play & Learn My First Korean
releases.summary:
See it. Fill in Hangul!

Can you recognize the right Korean word from a picture and its meaning?

If you are just starting out, learning a new language can feel intimidating. This game makes your first steps into Korean simple and fun.

Complete Korean words by filling in the blank with the correct Hangul. Illustrations and Japanese meanings help you understand familiar everyday words as you play.

How to play:
• Check the illustration and the Japanese meaning.
• Choose the correct Hangul from the answer choices.
• Complete the Korean word in the blank.

With 120 stages to play, you can gradually get used to Hangul letters and Korean vocabulary through a fun game-like experience.

Recommended for anyone who:
• Wants to start learning Korean
• Wants to learn Hangul in a fun way
• Wants to get familiar with Korean words
• Enjoys quizzes and fill-in-the-blank puzzles
• Wants to practice a language in short sessions

releases.name: MONO CHAMELEON
releases.summary: Hide-and-seek, tag AND prop hunt in one monochrome package. PAINT yourself into the walls, disguise as a prop, or hunt with the catch-gun. 2–10 player friendslop: proximity voice, 5 modes, bots, daily challenge. Like Prop Hunt, but chameleons — in stylish black-and-white.

releases.name: Novalex Project Zero
releases.summary: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

releases.name: Neon Rhythm Plus
releases.summary: The year is 2050, and technology has been outlawed. Deflect, dodge, and time your moves to the beat of the music in this action-rhythm game.

releases.name: Sheepscape
releases.summary: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding; from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

releases.name: Manala: Equinox War
releases.summary: Manala is a 2D card-combat MMORPG where Light and Darkness fight for the world. Pick a camp and class, build your deck, and battle in tactical duels. Raid enemy camps, conquer the map in faction PvP and climb the envoy ranks before the autumn equinox decides the year.

releases.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
releases.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

releases.name: Starfort
releases.summary: Defend your empire in a sci-fi tower defense game. Build deadly combinations of railguns, lasers, gravity wells, drones, and cannons across three maps, 50 levels per map, and four difficulty modes.

releases.name: Artificial Ambition
releases.summary: Grow your AI startup from a 2017 garage to an industry titan. Hire specialists, train models, and outsmart rivals. Build the future, but tread carefully—your relentless drive for progress might just open a Pandora's box of unintended power.

releases.name: Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past
releases.summary: A virtual exhibition recreating the first public museum in Lithuania—the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities. Open the doors to the mid-19th century, discover over 100 unique historical exhibits, talk to the founder of the museum himself, and learn about the fate of the collection.

releases.name: BOOMER (Wumbo Workshop)
releases.summary: BOOMER is a chaos-filled co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Inhabit a zany cast of customizable puppet characters as you explore derelict environments, encounter forgotten monsters and play a deadly game of hot potato with everyone's favorite little rascal, Boomer!

releases.name: Sort Them Fish
releases.summary: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

releases.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
releases.summary:
Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

releases.name: Swarmslam
releases.summary: Swarmslam is an idle incremental game about a swarm that smashes planets, cracks their core and moves on.You don't control them, you just give them directions, give them more power and watch ore fly left and right.Gather more power by cracking planets over and over again, invest ore to get otherworldly powers and become stronger, more efficient, until you satisfy THE CORE.Lots of planets, lots of ore, sinks, skill tree, ...COREBREAK prestige, ...even trading?.. and more.SLAM. CRACK. REPEAT.

releases.name: ESCAPE: The Cabin
releases.summary: Wake trapped inside a remote cabin with no memory of how you got there. Solve over 70 puzzles, uncover the truth behind your captor, and escape a mystery where clues, item locations, and even puzzle solutions change every playthrough.

releases.name: Swarm Harvest
releases.summary: SWARM HARVEST is a survivors-like auto-shooter where you command a growing army of drones and deployable towers. Carve through endless alien swarms and evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds.

releases.name: Moon Swarm
releases.summary: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

releases.name: Build the Hole
releases.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

releases.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
releases.summary: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

releases.name: Apple Catcher
releases.summary: Use your webcam to control the action in Apple Catcher, a colorful motion-controlled arcade game. Lean left and right to move your basket, catch apples, avoid sticks, clear increasingly challenging levels, and chase a high score in Endless Mode.

releases.name: ONE MORE TERM
releases.summary: Lead a republic through 48 months. Examine documents, manage your cabinet, pass laws, survive crises, and answer for the consequences of every political compromise.

releases.name: HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
releases.summary: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

releases.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
releases.summary: Grow, nurture and sell exquisite flowers from your own shop in old France. Plant seeds, tend each bloom with care, master dozens of species, and build a thriving florist as customers come seeking the perfect bouquet — all in first person, at your own peaceful pace.

releases.name: Futbolero: Football Career Simulator
releases.summary: Eternal idol or washed-up talent? Futbolero blends a football career sim, choice-driven roguelite, and key arcade minigames. Every run is a new life: from the streets to glory, juggling contracts, parties, and dynasties. Play solo or with friends in co-op or competitive PvP.

releases.name: BIGGER BANG
releases.summary: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every hit leaves a mark, and the hole stays between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from even farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

releases.name: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
releases.summary: You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb — through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs. Start with one.

releases.name: sys:tan restore
releases.summary: A short incremental game where you blast shapes to solve computer problems. Put together a party of computer caretakers with their own unique skill trees and give the system a deep clean!

releases.name: A Little Faraway
releases.summary: A peaceful island exploration game where you wander, swim, ride sea turtles and seagulls, experience changing weather and lunar cycles, discover special moments, and create memories at your own pace.

releases.name: Junkyard Reseller
releases.summary: Choose an AWESOME BLOCK MAN and race your way through the streets!! Be careful you don't crash into the Harlem Shakers, SCARY zombies, stick men and the ninjas....!!!!!!!!

releases.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
releases.summary: Roll dank gritty hallways, punching thugs in the face. Rampage Rage puts you right in the fight with 3-D graphics and quick fist-throwing action. Feel what it's like to be Quinton "Rampage" Jackson against an endless army headed your way.••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••MEDL Mobile and Quinton “Rampage” Jackson bring you the first official Quinton “Rampage” Jackson iPhone game!••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••Like Quinton says, “Love watching me knock a mofos out? Then you’ll love being me knocking a mofos out!” And who can argue with that? See how far down the hall you can get before the onslaught slows you down. And stay tuned for upgrades and updates coming soon. This is just the beginning of gaming for Rampage!••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••We are proud to call Rampage Rage a Shiny MEDL Object!

releases.name: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
releases.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

releases.name: Pre-Warp Age
releases.summary: A meditative turn-based strategy about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems without enemies or time limits.

releases.name: Rollamech
releases.summary: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.
